passages.title: Predicting the Role of Political Trolls in Social Media
passages.text: The behavior of political trolls has been ana- lyzed in different recent circumstances, such as the 2016 US Presidential Elections and the Brexit referendum in UK (Linvill and Warren, 2018; Llewellyn et al., 2018). However, this kind of analysis requires painstaking and time-consuming manual labor to sift through the data and to catego- rize the trolls according to their actions. Our goal in the current paper is to automate this process with the help of machine learning (ML).
